statement: The executable A0 step package covers all seventeen instruction families, their declared effects, all four trap classes, terminal stuttering, and complete-state frame containment for the coverage cases.
scope: One nondegenerate width-8 execution and exact effect row per instruction family, four trap controls, and terminal halt/trap states.

checker.expected_result: PASS: families=17 effects=17 traps=4 stutter=true frame=true

negative_control.mutates: Independently add an undeclared r7 write, omit an addition condition update, and replace sequential pc+4 with pc+1

limitations: Family coverage and exact effect rows do not exhaust every possible state.
The route has computation trust and no independent certificate.
